resources.string: Scores are saved on this device as each point is earned.
This app is completely offline. It collects nothing, sends nothing and shows no ads. It has no internet permission at all. The only things saved on this device are these settings.
Please read this before your child plays. It appears only once.
Bubble Learn Kids is free, works completely offline, shows no advertising and collects no information about you or your child. Tap OK to begin.

Bubble Learn Kids collects no personal information, sends nothing over the internet, and shows no advertising. It works entirely on your device.

INFORMATION WE COLLECT
None. The app never asks for a name, an email address, an age, a photo, a contact or a location. There is no sign-up and no user account. We do not use cookies or advertising identifiers.

INFORMATION WE SEND
None. The app does not request the Android internet permission, so it cannot send data anywhere at all. The only permission it asks for is permission to vibrate, used for the small buzz when a balloon pops.

OTHER COMPANIES
The app contains no advertising network, no analytics, no crash reporting and no social media links.

SAVED ON THIS DEVICE
The app remembers your settings so it can start the way you left it: sound, background sounds and vibration, balloon speed and size, high contrast, whether the first-time hint has been shown, and a short list of recent scores. This stays on the device, is never sent anywhere, and is removed when the app is uninstalled.

CHILDREN
The app is made for children aged about two to five, to be used with a grown-up nearby. Because it collects and transmits nothing at all, it does not process personal information of children under 13 under COPPA, nor personal data of anyone under the GDPR.

PURCHASES AND LINKS
There are no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, and no links that take a child out of the app.

YOUR RIGHTS
We hold no information about you, so there is nothing to request, correct or delete. Uninstalling the app removes everything it saved on the device.

CHANGES
If the app ever changes in a way that affects this policy, this page will be updated before the new version is released.

By using Bubble Learn Kids you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

LICENCE
You may install and use the app on devices you own, for private, non-commercial use. This does not transfer ownership of the app to you.

WHAT YOU MAY NOT DO
You may not sell, rent or redistribute the app as your own, remove notices of ownership, or use it for any unlawful purpose.

SUPERVISING CHILDREN
The app is intended for young children and is designed to be used with a parent or carer present. Grown-ups are responsible for supervising use, including how long a child spends on a screen.

FREE, WITH NO PURCHASES
The app is free. It contains no advertising, no in-app purchases and no subscriptions. If that ever changes, it will be described in the store listing before release.

UPDATES AND AVAILABILITY
We may update, change or withdraw the app at any time. We do not promise it will always be available, or that it will work on every device or every version of Android.

PROVIDED AS IS
The app is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. We do not warrant that it will be free of errors or interruptions.

LIMITS OF RESPONSIBILITY
So far as the law allows, we are not responsible for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of the app. Nothing here limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

OWNERSHIP
The app, including its code, artwork and name, belongs to its developer, except for components licensed from others, which remain theirs.

CHANGES TO THESE TERMS
We may update these terms. Continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated terms.
